items.anchor_event: notice that the same is due
items.description: Tenant must timely pay undisputed Rent and other charges; failure to pay within the notice period is an Event of Default.
items.span_text: Any failure or refusal by Tenant to timely pay any undisputed* portions of Rent or other payments or charges required to be paid hereunder, within ten (10) days of notice that the same is due.

items.anchor_event: written notice to Tenant of such failure
items.description: Tenant must cure a failure to perform or observe other lease covenants within the cure period after written notice, or it becomes an Event of Default.
items.span_text: if such failure continues for a period of thirty (30) days following written notice to Tenant of such failure

items.description: Tenant must remedy an ECT Overage within the stated hours after receiving an ECT Default Notice, and repeated overages in a rolling period are an Event of Default.
items.span_text: it shall be an Event of Default by Tenant (i) if Tenant fails to remedy* an ECT Overage within one hundred twenty (120) hours after its receipt of an ECT Default Notice, and/or (ii) if three (3) separate and distinct ECT Overages occur in any rolling thirty (30) day period.
items.trigger: if Tenant fails to remedy* an ECT Overage within one hundred twenty (120) hours after its receipt of an ECT Default Notice

items.anchor_event: delivery of written notice of such failure by Landlord to Tenant
items.description: Tenant must execute and deliver requested statements or documents on time, and failure continuing after written notice is an Event of Default.
items.span_text: Any failure by Tenant to execute and deliver any statement or document described in Article 11, Section 12.1 or Section 17.21 requested to be so executed and delivered by Landlord within the time periods specified in such Article or Section, where such failure continues for ten (10) days after delivery of written notice of such failure by Landlord to Tenant.

items.description: Upon a Tenant Event of Default, Landlord may pursue damages, specific performance, injunctive relief and the remedies in Exhibit D.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, in addition to an action for money damages, specific performance and/or injunctive relief, have the option to pursue any one or more of the remedies described in Section 1 of Exhibit “D” attached hereto
items.trigger: Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default by Tenant

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to give Tenant daily updates on progress of curing its failure.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to provide daily updates to Tenant regarding progress toward such completion.

items.description: Landlord must transfer any security given by Tenant to its successor in interest when it conveys the Property.
items.span_text: If any security has been given by Tenant to secure the faithful performance of any of the covenants of this Lease, Landlord shall transfer or deliver said security, as such, to Landlord’s successor in interest
items.trigger: If any security has been given by Tenant to secure the faithful performance of any of the covenants of this Lease

items.description: Landlord remains responsible for ensuring that obligations partly assigned to a third party are properly performed.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, subject to the terms of Sections 14.1, 14.2 and 16.2, retain the responsibility for ensuring that the assigned obligations are properly performed under this Lease
items.trigger: Should Landlord assign part of its obligation to a third party
